headline: Pafos have no points — and are still clear favourites against Riga
summary: Pafos are 32nd of 36 in the Conference League with 0 points after a 1-3 defeat at Atalanta on matchday one. They host Riga on Thursday. Riga arrive unbeaten in 5 matches and, according to Spanish media, have scored in each of their last 10 games. Even so, the market average, with the margin removed, makes Pafos 59.5% favourites, up from 57.1% in recent days, and rates them about a goal the better side on the handicap. Riga's chance is 17.3%. The goal line sits at 2.75 — a game the market expects to be open.
read: Pafos are clear home favourites at 59.5% even though they sit 32nd of 36 with no points, while Riga arrive unbeaten in five and scoring in every one of their last ten matches. The market expects just under three goals, and the price on the home side has firmed from 57.1% to 59.5% in recent days.

facts.fact: Pafos are rated 59.5% to win at home, more than three times Riga's 17.3%, with the draw at 23.2%.
facts.meaning: The market makes a Pafos win more likely than not, despite their poor start in the competition.

facts.fact: Pafos are 32nd of 36 in the Conference League table with zero points from their opening match.
facts.meaning: They need a first win here or the league phase starts to run away from them.

facts.fact: Riga are unbeaten in five matches — WDWWW, four wins, seven goals scored and two conceded.
facts.meaning: They arrive as the form side and drew their Conference League opener 1-1 at home to Kairat.

facts.fact: The market sets the goal total at 2.75, with over priced at 49.1% — close to a coin flip.
facts.meaning: Just under three goals is the expected game: open, but not a shootout.

facts.fact: Riga have scored at least one goal in each of their last 10 matches across all competitions.
facts.meaning: Pafos are unlikely to keep a clean sheet, which matters for a side giving a goal on the handicap.

facts.fact: Around 4,000 Pafos fans are reported to be travelling to Limassol to support the team in this European match.
facts.meaning: The home side should have a large, noisy backing behind them for a game they need to win.

facts.fact: Pafos played on Sunday, three days before kick-off; Riga played on Saturday and had four days.
facts.meaning: Both sides are on a short turnaround, with Riga holding one extra day of recovery.
